title: Static 'My Might is increased by your points' does nothing on the VEN reprint
expected: ven.json:4714-4734 defines ven-172-166 with rulesText "My Might is increased by your points.", abilities:[], parseSuccess:false. adaptJsonCard (all-cards.ts:805-807) turns [] into undefined, so enrichCard (enrich-cards.ts:22-33) re-parses rulesText, but parseAbilities returns {success:false,"Could not parse ability text"} (verified by running the parser via bun). Result: getCardRegistry().get("ven-172-166").abilities === undefined, while ogn-028-298 gets the hand-authored static modify-might {amount:{score:'self'}} from cards/ogn/draven-showboat.ts:12-21. There is no cards/ven/ override directory and no name-based reprint inheritance in all-cards.ts/enrich-cards.ts, so the VEN printing has no static ability and gets no Might bonus from points.
observed: After conquering Aspirant's Climb (players.player-1.victoryPoints = 1), Draven's meta had no staticMightBonus/mightModifier and might stayed 3; UI showed no buff badge. Root cause: the loaded def for ven-172-166 has no `abilities` at all (ven.json entry has abilities:[] / parseSuccess:false and the parser can't handle this text), whereas the OGN printing ogn-028-298 carries a hand-authored static {type:'modify-might', amount:{score:'self'}, target:'self'}. The VEN reprint never inherits it.
